slice: Slice 4 — canonical review projection + cursor/decl-generation disclosure
thesis: Add a deterministic, diffable review projection of a vertex's folded state — sorted by (kind,key), whitelisted to only emit-derived fields, with each fact's signature carried verbatim from the store, under a header disclosing the read's cursor position and the declaration generation that interpreted the facts. This is a new read-only surface built entirely over the EXISTING fold fetch + declaration-status machinery; it deliberately stops short of the loops-go SPEC §10 total-dump (witness-ordered every-row JSONL, JCS byte-determinism, rebuild round-trip, chain) which is gated on GlobalReceiptPosition. Two supporting disclosures ride along: extending the 0.8.0 cursor mode-line to HEAD reads (today only --at/--as-of emit it), and a declaration-generation fingerprint that exists nowhere today.

files.role: Home of the new canonical review encoder (to_review) + its deterministic (kind,key) sort and field whitelist. Sits beside the existing to_dict encoder (lines 1017-1040). Painted-free leaf; must stay so.

Add the --review short-circuit branch in run() (same pattern as --why at 581-594 and --diff at 599-600) that fetches the fold, resolves cursor (head or --at/--as-of), computes decl generation, and emits the canonical JSON. Also add head-cursor resolution for the default (no --at/--as-of) path via a small extension around lines 605-616.
Declare the --review flag (store_true) alongside --at/--as-of/--diff (lines 109-133) so the fold parser and completion/-h see it.

New declaration_generation() helper (reuses resolve_declaration_documents at 219-431 and load_declaration_status at 445-515) returning the generation fingerprint + status + lineage. Honest across both the adopted-store and pre-genesis-file residences.

New read-only fact_signatures(ids)->dict[id,str|None] helper (SELECT id, signature FROM facts WHERE id IN (...)); guarded on the signature column existing (mirror the PRAGMA probe at 211-224). Verbatim column read, never recompute.
Export declaration_generation and fact_signatures (or a store-path wrapper).
Optionally refuse --review combined with --facts/--ticks/--diff (fold-route-only concern), mirroring the --at/--diff route-guard at 56-68.

New test file: determinism (byte-identical across two reads of unchanged state), whitelist enforcement (no salience/tier/inbound/window keys), signature-per-fact inclusion + null-on-unsigned, header cursor + decl-generation shape, aggregate/pre-genesis degradation.
If head-cursor disclosure is turned on for the DEFAULT TTY read (arbiter fork), the fold goldens churn and must be regenerated with --update-goldens.

current_behavior: read --json (gate-pass path) emits surface.to_dict (surface.py:1017-1040): top-level keys {vertex, rows, schema, unfolded, source_facts, window} — verified empirically. Three concrete gaps vs a review artifact: (1) TRAVERSAL ORDER is fold order, not canonical — project() walks sections in vertex DECLARATION order (vertex_reader.py:892-898 'Declaration order from AST') and items within a by-fold in items_raw.values() = fold-state dict insertion / first-seen-key (emit) order (vertex_reader.py:927-928); surface.py:552-566 documents this as 'FAITHFUL FOLD ORDER'. Two stores with identical folded state but different emit order diff spuriously. (2) DIFF-NOISE fields: _row_to_dict (surface.py:977-1002) emits salience, tier, inbound, inbound_predicates, depth, via_anchor, granularity — all read-time DERIVED (inbound/salience change when OTHER facts emit refs; tier is a population quantile via _assign_tiers surface.py:532-542) — plus to_dict includes top-level window (a read-time slice artifact) and schema ranking hints. (3) OMITS SIGNATURE: _row_to_dict has no signature; atoms.FoldItem carries none (fold_state.py:37-82); signatures live ONLY in the store column facts.signature (sqlite_store.py:283-291, nullable), keyed by fact id, never threaded into the fold/Surface path (verified: read --json row has no 'signature' key; project store has 658/3123 signed facts). Cursor disclosure: fold.py:605-616 builds cursor_meta ONLY when args.at or args.as_of; dispatch merges it into JSON (dispatch.py:310-328) and the fold lens prepends cursor_mode_line (lenses/fold.py:226-245, wired at 414-421). A plain head read builds no cursor_meta, so no cursor line renders (verified: 0 cursor lines on `sl read project`). --at head DOES resolve a witness position even on a pre-genesis/unadopted store (verified: seq 3123, status file-pre-genesis, anchor present) via resolve_at_address(store,'head') -> resolve_witness_position (witness_address.py:178-179). Declaration generation: NOTHING today discloses which generation of declarations produced a read; load_declaration_status (declaration.py:445-515) returns only a coarse status label ('store'|'file-pre-genesis'|'unhistorized'|'aggregate-head', declaration.py:434-442). Project store is pre-genesis (0 _decl rows, no store_meta) — the dominant live case.

planned_changes.step: 1. Confirm the SPEC §10 boundary and encode it in the brief/docstrings
planned_changes.description: Read loops-go/SPEC.md §9 (927-1187) and §10 (1189-1246). §10.1 defines the DUMP as ONE JSONL stream of EVERY row (facts + declaration events + ticks) in WITNESS order (§8.4); §10.2 makes it JCS byte-deterministic; §10.3 requires rebuild(dump(S)) chain-validity + dump(rebuild(dump(S))) byte-identity; §10.4 adds per-vertex residence modes + transit receipts; §10.5 sequences all §10 vectors AFTER the _canonical_bytes->JCS migration (a hard constraint) and the whole layer is PROVISIONAL, gated on GlobalReceiptPosition (loops-go coordination batch). The BUILDABLE CORE STOPS SHORT of ALL of that: the review projection encodes FOLDED ENTITY state (one row per kind/key), sorted by (kind,key) for human diffability — NOT witness order, NOT every row, NO ticks, NO declaration-event rows, NO chain. Its determinism is 'same folded state -> same bytes' (a review property), explicitly NOT §10.2 canonical-interchange bytes; it is NOT an encoding and is NOT rebuildable (§10.3 does not apply). Building anything witness-ordered/rebuildable/JCS-canonical here would fork the interchange contract — refuse it. Docstrings must say 'review snapshot, not interchange dump'.

planned_changes.step: 2. Add engine helper: fact_signatures(store_path, ids) -> {id: signature|None}
planned_changes.description: Read-only batched lookup of the facts.signature column by id. Open the store read-only (mode=ro, mirroring declaration._open_readonly at declaration.py:201-216 and the slice-2 read-purity posture); PRAGMA-probe the signature column (mirror store_reader.py:211-224) and return all-None if the column is absent (pre-signature store). CUSTODY: read the column verbatim, never recompute or re-sign (matches sqlite_store append signature_override posture at 492-520). This is the ONLY source of per-fact signatures for the projection — the fold path drops them entirely.

planned_changes.step: 3. Add engine helper: declaration_generation(vertex_path, *, at=None, as_of=None) -> dict
planned_changes.description: Reuse load_declaration_status (declaration.py:445-515) for the status label and residence detection, and resolve_declaration_documents (219-431) for the folded declaration document set on adopted stores. Return {status, lineage, generation, head?}. RECOMMENDED minimal mechanism (see open question): generation = a plain sha256 fingerprint over a deterministically-serialized projection of the resolved declaration (the document set on an adopted store; the file's parsed declaration content on a pre-genesis store) — ONE fingerprint honest in BOTH residences, answering 'did the ontology change between two reads'. Label it a REVIEW fingerprint, NOT §10.2 JCS canonical bytes. On adopted stores ALSO surface head = id (ULID) of the latest-applied self-lineage _decl.* event within the cutoff (rebuild-stable, unlike rowid). On pre-genesis stores (0 _decl rows — the project store today) lineage=null, head=null, status='file-pre-genesis'. Aggregates report status='aggregate-head' (membership is current file state, declaration.py:482-492).

planned_changes.step: 4. Add surface.to_review(state, *, header) -> dict — the canonical encoder
planned_changes.description: Operate on the fetched FoldState (NOT the derived Surface — the whitelist is exactly atoms.FoldItem's own fields, so no Surface scalars are needed). Iterate state.sections ONLY (ignore walked ref-graph reach — that's a read-time graph, not folded self-state). For each item build a row: {kind, key (the fold-key value or null), key_field, payload (with SORTED keys), id, ts, observer, origin, n, refs (sorted), edges [{predicate,address}], signature (verbatim from fact_signatures by item.id, or null)}. WHITELIST = FoldItem fields + address + signature; EXCLUDE every read-time derivation (salience, tier, inbound, inbound_predicates, depth, via_anchor, granularity) and the Surface window/schema-ranking. Sort rows deterministically by (kind, key or '', id) so keyless collect rows order by id. Emit {header, facts: [...]} with json.dumps(..., sort_keys=True) so two reads of unchanged state are byte-identical. Keep surface.py painted-free; the signature lookup is injected by the caller (pass signatures dict in) OR call the engine helper via a local import like _indexed_kinds does (surface.py:744-758) — prefer injecting the dict so surface stays a leaf.

planned_changes.step: 5. Wire --review as a fold-route short-circuit in fold.py::run
planned_changes.description: Declare --review in read_args.add_read_args (read_args.py:109-133). In fold.py::run, after cursor resolution, add a branch (patterned on _run_why 581-594 / _run_diff 599-600 which own their JSON) that: resolves the cursor (head when no --at/--as-of via step 6; else the already-resolved at_position/as_of_ts + cursor_meta), calls fetch_fold(vertex_path, kind=kind, key=fetch_key, at=at_position, as_of=as_of_ts) for the FoldState, batches signatures via engine.fact_signatures using every item.id, computes engine.declaration_generation(vertex_path, at=..., as_of=...), assembles header={vertex, cursor: cursor_meta, declaration: <gen>}, and prints surface.to_review(state, header=header). --review is JSON-only (a machine artifact); ignore/refuse TTY-render flags. In read.py refuse --review with --facts/--ticks/--diff (fold-route-only, mirror 56-68).

planned_changes.step: 6. Extend cursor disclosure to HEAD reads
planned_changes.description: Add a helper in fold.py that, when neither --at nor --as-of is set AND the vertex is a single store (not aggregate — reuse witness_address.is_aggregate_vertex, witness_address.py:43-48), resolves the head position via resolve_at_address(store_path,'head') + load_declaration_status(vertex_path, at=head_pos) and builds a cursor_meta dict shaped like the --at path (fold.py:332-343) but flagged as head (e.g. address='head', add a 'head': true marker) so the mode-line can phrase 'at head' vs an explicit rewind. Verified this resolves even on pre-genesis/unadopted stores (durable_handle null, portable false, unadopted true — the existing honesty fields already carry the caveat). Aggregates: skip (no witness head) — emit no cursor or a mode='head' status='aggregate-head' with no position. For the --review header this head cursor_meta is ALWAYS populated (in scope, no golden churn — new surface). Whether to ALSO thread it into the DEFAULT TTY/JSON read (so `sl read project` grows a mode-line) is the arbiter fork below; if yes, thread cursor_meta into render_context exactly as fold.py:733-736 and regenerate fold goldens.

test_plan: Determinism: emit the same logical fold twice in different emit order into two temp stores (or reuse a fixture); assert to_review bytes are identical (sort_keys + (kind,key) sort). Contrast: assert to_dict rows differ in order for the same pair (documents the gap).

Whitelist: assert no row in --review output carries salience/tier/inbound/inbound_predicates/depth/via_anchor/granularity, and the top level carries no window/schema; assert it DOES carry payload/id/ts/observer/origin/n/refs/edges/signature.

Signature-per-fact: on a store with mixed signed/unsigned facts (project store has 658/3123), assert signed folded rows carry the verbatim column value and unsigned rows carry null; assert the signature equals a direct SELECT (no recomputation).

Header cursor at head: `sl read project --review` header.cursor.mode=='witness'/head marker, address=='head', status=='file-pre-genesis', unadopted true, portable false, anchor present — matches the empirically-confirmed --at head shape.
Header cursor with --at/--as-of: `--review --at seq:N` and `--review --as-of 30d` carry the corresponding cursor_meta; `--review --at X --as-of Y` refused (A8, read.py:124-130).

Declaration generation: pre-genesis store -> {status:'file-pre-genesis', lineage:null, generation:<hash>}; two reads of an unchanged store -> identical generation; editing the .vertex file changes the fingerprint. (If an adopted-store fixture exists, assert head = latest _decl id.)
Aggregate degradation: `--review` on a combine/discover vertex reports status 'aggregate-head' and no witness head position (no crash).

Head disclosure on default read (only if the arbiter turns it on): golden regeneration + a targeted test that `sl read project` (no flags) now prints a cursor mode-line and `--json` carries a cursor field.
Read-purity: assert --review opens stores read-only and does not mutate the store (file mtime / FTS unchanged) — consistent with slice-2 posture.
Router guard: `--review --facts`, `--review --ticks`, `--review --diff A..B` are refused with a teaching message.

Run the existing suites unchanged: uv run --package loops pytest apps/loops/tests (esp. test_surface.py, test_fold_view_cursor.py, golden/test_fold_surface_paths.py) and uv run --package engine pytest libs/engine/tests. After CLI changes, uv tool install . -e then exercise `sl read project --review` directly.
acceptance_criteria: `sl read <vertex> --review` emits JSON {header, facts:[...]} where facts are sorted by (kind,key) and byte-identical across repeated reads of unchanged folded state.

Each fact row carries payload (sorted keys), id, ts, observer, origin, n, refs, edges, and signature (verbatim store column, or null when unsigned) — and carries NONE of salience/tier/inbound/inbound_predicates/depth/via_anchor/granularity/window/schema.

header.cursor discloses the read's position: head for a plain --review, or the resolved witness/event-time position for --at/--as-of, using the existing cursor_meta shape (status, unadopted, portable, anchor, durable_handle).

header.declaration discloses status + a generation fingerprint that is stable across unchanged reads and changes when the declaration changes, honest on both adopted-store and pre-genesis-file residences.
Signatures are read verbatim; no code path re-signs or recomputes a signature. No tick-chain fields are included. An unadopted store is disclosed as unadopted/non-portable, never silently adopted.

The projection is strictly read-only (stores opened mode=ro; no store mutation) and stops short of SPEC §10: no witness-ordered every-row stream, no JCS byte-determinism claim, no rebuild round-trip, no chain — docstrings state this explicitly.
HEAD reads can emit the cursor disclosure (the mechanism exists and is wired into the review header); existing --at/--as-of behavior is unchanged.
Full existing test + golden suites pass (goldens regenerated only if the arbiter enables default-read head disclosure).
risks: Golden blast radius: if head-cursor disclosure is turned on for the DEFAULT read, every fold golden (the most-used command's output) churns — a large, reviewable-but-noisy diff. Mitigation: keep default-read head disclosure behind the arbiter fork; the review header carries head cursor with zero golden impact.

surface.py is a painted-free LEAF that the lens depends on; adding a signature lookup there could pull an engine import to module scope. Mitigation: inject the signatures dict from the caller (fold.py), keep the engine call out of surface.py, or use the same in-function local-import pattern as _indexed_kinds (surface.py:744-758).

Determinism traps: json.dumps default key order + float ts repr + payload nested dicts. Mitigation: sort_keys=True end to end, sort payload/refs, and a round-trip determinism test. Do NOT reach for JCS/RFC-8785 here — that is §10.2 territory sequenced after the _canonical_bytes->JCS migration (SPEC §10.5); a plain sorted sha256 fingerprint is sufficient and must be labeled review-only.

Declaration-generation semantics: a content hash over the file (pre-genesis) vs the document set (adopted) hashes two different spaces; a naive file hash (mtime/whitespace) would over- or under-report change. Mitigation: hash the PARSED declaration projection, not raw bytes, so cosmetic edits don't churn and semantic edits do.

FoldItem.id for a by-fold is the LATEST contributing fact (fold_state.py:51-54); its signature is the winning fact's authorship — correct for a folded-head review, but the impl agent must not assume it signs the whole key history.

Aggregate/storeless vertices have no witness head and no single store for signatures — the review path must degrade honestly (status aggregate-head, null signatures/generation) rather than crash, mirroring the existing --at aggregate refusal (witness_address.py:68-103).
dependencies: Slice 2 (FTS read-purity) is assumed landed: the review projection is a snapshot-for-review and must be strictly read-only. The encoder itself triggers no FTS (no --match), but its signature + declaration-generation lookups must use read-only connections consistent with slice-2's 'store reindex is the sole FTS writer / read-only vertex_search' posture.

Existing 0.8.0 temporal-cursor machinery: fold.py::_resolve_cursor (282-361), witness_address.resolve_at_address (151-246), engine.load_declaration_status / resolve_declaration_documents (declaration.py:219-515), lenses/fold.cursor_mode_line (226-245), dispatch cursor merge (310-328). Reused, not rebuilt.

Custody substrate already implemented: facts.signature column (sqlite_store.py:283-291), signature_override verbatim-preserve posture (492-520), witness adoption marker / durable_handle (witness.py, declaration._read_own_lineage 175-188).
GlobalReceiptPosition + the loops-go SPEC §10 total-dump are a HARD NON-dependency: the buildable core must not depend on or anticipate them.
After CLI changes: uv tool install . -e, then exercise `sl read project --review` directly (per CLAUDE.md install-path discipline).
open_questions: Declaration-generation mechanism (the one genuine fork): (a) a content-hash fingerprint over the resolved declaration — works honestly in BOTH residences and gives a single comparable value, but introduces a new hashing contract that must be carefully kept distinct from SPEC §10.2 JCS canonical bytes; vs (b) the decl-head event id (ULID of the latest-applied self-lineage _decl.* event) — simpler and rebuild-stable, but store-only, so pre-genesis (the dominant case today) has no comparable value and can only report a 'file' sentinel. Recommend (a) as the default (labeled a review fingerprint), with (b)'s head id ALSO surfaced on adopted stores. Needs arbiter sign-off because it defines a new disclosed contract field.

Head-cursor disclosure scope: should the head mode-line render on EVERY default read (`sl read project` gains a persistent cursor line — the design's symmetric-honesty aim per cursor_mode_line's docstring, but all fold goldens churn and the most-used command's output changes), or ONLY inside the --review header and --json cursor field (default TTY read visually unchanged, lower blast radius)? Recommend review-header + JSON disclosure now, and treat always-on TTY head disclosure as a separate opt-in the arbiter can flip.
measures: Byte-determinism: two --review reads of unchanged folded state produce identical bytes (assert equality).
Whitelist coverage: count of forbidden keys (salience/tier/inbound/inbound_predicates/depth/via_anchor/granularity/window/schema) present in --review output == 0.

Signature coverage: for the project store, signed folded rows carrying a verbatim signature vs total (baseline 658/3123 facts signed) — signed rows must carry the column value, unsigned must carry null.
Declaration-generation stability: fingerprint unchanged across N repeated reads of an unedited store; changed after one .vertex edit.
